parameters.name: AttackPathAssetList
parameters.description: The list of cloud service assets in the attack path.

sub_parameters.name: AssetSubType
sub_parameters.description:
The subtype of the cloud service asset.

> Call [ListSupportAttackPathAsset](~~ListSupportAttackPathAsset~~) to query the subtypes of cloud service assets.

sub_parameters.name: AssetType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the cloud service asset.

> Call [ListSupportAttackPathAsset](~~ListSupportAttackPathAsset~~) to query the types of cloud service assets.

sub_parameters.name: NodeType
sub_parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
- **start**: start node.
- **end**: end node.

sub_parameters.name: Vendor
sub_parameters.description:
The vendor of the cloud service asset.
> Call [ListSupportAttackPathAsset](~~ListSupportAttackPathAsset~~) to query the vendors of cloud service assets.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time as a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: PathNameDesc
parameters.description:
The path name description.
> Call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query path name descriptions.

parameters.name: PathType
parameters.description:
The path type.
> Call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query path types.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time as a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
